shots.visual: Extreme close-up on a terrified officer's sweating face, looking down. Hand holds a map with a red X.
Cao Pi sits on a lavish but cold throne, face pale, gripping the armrest tightly. His eyes are wide with fear.
Wide shot of a massive Wei army across the river. Tents are being hastily packed. Atmosphere is chaotic and fearful.
Liu Bei stands alone on the Shu side bank, wind blowing his robes. He is small in the frame against the vast river and enemy army.
Close-up on Liu Bei's face. He is calm, eyes open, staring across the water. No emotion of fear, only determination.
Liu Bei raises his head slightly. A faint, cold smile appears. He takes a deep breath.
Liu Bei's mouth opens. His eyes flash with a sudden, intense power. The air seems to vibrate slightly.
A shockwave ripples out from Liu Bei visually (VFX). The sound is a deep, resonant roar that silences the wind.
The entire Wei army stands frozen. Banners stop moving. Total silence. The fear is palpable.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 聲如洪鐘，壓得陣營鴉雀無聲。

shots.visual: Pan across the front line of Wei soldiers. They are trembling, lowering their weapons. Some are on their knees.
Close-up on a Wei soldier's hand releasing a spear, which clatters to the ground. Sweat drops on his face.
Liu Bei stands tall, looking down at the river. His presence feels like a mountain. He exudes absolute confidence.
Cao Pi is shaking. His advisor (background, blurred) tries to comfort him, but Cao Pi waves him off.
Cao Pi slams the table. His face is twisted in rage and terror. He looks at his advisor with sharp, paranoid eyes.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 他憑什麼？就憑他一個人？

shots.visual: Cao Pi's eyes dart around, glancing at the door as if expecting an attack. He hugs his arms, looking small and weak.
The Wei army begins to retreat. Banners are pulled down. The formation breaks, looking disorganized and defeated.
